example_segments: Ubiquitous within modern society lies the need for students to remain focused within learning environments, bringing into question whether mobile phones should be restricted during class.

In light of this, Sarah Miller firmly contends that mobile phones should be restricted during class as they pose a significant distraction to students within her opinion piece entitled “Put the Phones Away”.
Appealing directly towards parents, teachers and students, Miller supplements her piece with an image of a student distracted by their phone during class in order to substantiate her piece.
Ultimately, Miller strongly calls for schools to restrict mobile-phone use during class as only then can students remain focused and engaged in their learning.
